PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp Reports Steady Trade Activity in UAE Oil & Gas Sector

PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp reported stable trade figures for the most recent quarter, reflecting continued demand for oilfield services and equipment in the United Arab Emirates. The company’s latest disclosures show routine growth in both imports and exports of technical equipment, as the region’s energy sector maintains its pace of operations.

Company officials noted that shipments of drilling and maintenance equipment met expectations, with total trade volumes remaining consistent with last year’s levels. “We are pleased to see steady activity across our UAE operations,” said Tran Minh Hoang, Senior Trade Manager at PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp. “Our teams continue to serve key clients in Abu Dhabi and Dubai, supporting upstream projects and field maintenance without interruption.”

According to figures released by the UAE Oil & Gas Trade Association, industry-wide imports of oilfield equipment increased by 2.4% over the previous quarter. Exports of technical services from the UAE also saw a marginal uptick, rising 1.8% year-on-year. Analysts attribute this performance to ongoing investment in brownfield upgrades and moderate expansion in offshore operations.

“The market remains stable, with no significant disruptions to supply chains or project timelines reported,” said Lina Al-Mansoori, an energy sector analyst at Gulf Markets Insights. “Companies such as PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp have benefited from predictable logistics and persistent demand among local producers.”

Union representatives echoed this assessment, highlighting continued employment and regular work schedules for field technicians and support staff. “Our members report normal workloads and no indication of layoffs or project delays,” said Ahmed Saleh, spokesperson for the Energy Services Union.

The broader industry outlook remains cautiously optimistic as the UAE’s energy sector pursues incremental growth. With regional authorities maintaining licensing rounds and infrastructure investment, service providers anticipate further opportunities in both onshore and offshore segments. No major challenges or market disruptions have been reported, underpinning steady trade flows for firms like PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp.
